summary:
Buy 31 ceiling air devices — 28 ceiling supply diffusers and 3 ceiling return grilles. All are Price, all new (no salvage/reuse).

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSERS — Price SCD, louvered-face square 4-cone steel, 360deg fixed pattern, full-faced louvers, factory-insulated backpan, WHITE, 4-way throw, in a 24x24 panel for lay-in ceiling, with radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9 or equal). Four neck sizes:
  - Tag A, 6" round neck ....... 5 ea (75, 75, 75, 90, 130 CFM)
  - Tag B, 8" round neck ....... 4 ea (150, 150, 140, 140 CFM)
  - Tag C, 10" round neck ...... 15 ea (250, 200, 250, 250, 250, 200, 350, 350, 350, 300, 375, 375, 300, 375, 375 CFM)
  - Tag D, 12" round neck ...... 1 ea (500 CFM)
  Subtotal 25 ea lay-in SCD.

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSER, SURFACE MOUNT — Tag J, Price SMD, 12x12 face with 8" round neck, louvered-face high-capacity steel, WHITE, 4-way, FLANGED FRAME for surface mounting (hard/gyp ceiling, not lay-in), with opposed-blade damper: 3 ea (175, 150, 150 CFM) in the toilet/shower area.

Total ceiling supply = 28 ea, 6,550 CFM.

CEILING RETURN/EXHAUST GRILLES — Tag F, Price 80, 24" x 24" CORE, all-aluminum 1/2" x 1/2" x 1/2" egg crate, core-only panel, WHITE, lay-in: 3 ea (1 at the new FCU-1 in the addition, 2 in Mtg Room 106). No CFM tagged. Per M101 keynote 4, each needs a new 24x24 lined (1/2" liner) plenum built on top; keynote 28 adds a rectangular-to-round adapter atop the return grille.

WHAT I DID NOT COUNT (and why): tags E (4 ea 30x18), G (4 ea 36x36), H (3 ea 18x8) and I (4 ea 14x8) are all SIDEWALL grilles per the M601 GRILLES schedule notes 10 and 11 — 15 wall units in total, priced separately. Note that E and I carry the asterisk on M601 = field verify exact grille dimension before ordering (M101 keynote 7 says the engineer could not field-measure the existing return openings; approx. 30x18 each).

ALSO ON THE MECHANICAL SHEETS, not part of the 31: three ceiling exhaust fans, EF-1 and EF-2 (Greenheck SPA-700, 450 CFM each) and EF-3 (Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM) — these ship with an integral grille, so no separate grille purchase. And M101 keynote 19 calls for one 14x14 egg crate, Price model 82, mounted in the exterior soffit with an insect screen on the back — a soffit intake, not a room ceiling vent.

COORDINATION: M601 general note 3 requires ceiling register locations to be coordinated with the lighting layout, sprinkler heads and ceiling grid — refer to the architectural reflected ceiling plans for exact locations. Locations only; quantities and types are as scheduled above.

SHEETS USED: M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan) for the device count and keynotes; M601 (Mechanical Legend, General Notes & Schedules) for the GRILLES and EXHAUST FANS schedules; MD101 (Mechanical Demolition Floor Plan) to confirm the existing ceiling supply and return grilles are removed (demo keynotes 8, 14, 16, 42) with new grilles installed per the new work drawings — nothing is salvaged or reused, so the full 31 are a new buy.
